note: Wave 14 — the last two enumerated unknowns. Both turned out to be resolvable, and both were masked by a stale source: AARF had been renamed AARFA, and NJCSCR's cited guide was two cycles old. Every enumerated row in the corpus now carries a sourced status.

updates.status_evidence: The fellowship now runs as the Alzheimer's Association Research Fellowship Program for All (AARFA): letters of intent due 14 August 2026, full applications 14 October 2026, notifications by 30 January 2027.
updates.notes_append: RENAME 2026-09-18, and the reason the old page read “This grant is currently closed” with a February 2025 deadline and no next cycle: AARF has been superseded by the Research Fellowship Program for All (AARFA). source_url repointed. Award terms on the new page match the recorded figures (total not exceeding $200,000, research budget up to $180,000, two to three years). Eligibility now reads: doctoral degree, within 10 years of the terminal degree at LOI, not holding an independent faculty position, open to US and international researchers. program_name should follow the rename on the next editorial pass.

updates.notes_append: SOURCE REPOINTED 2026-09-18: the row cited the NJCSCR-1/2023 programme guide for the 2024 cycle. The stable grant-information page is used instead of a cycle-specific PDF, so the row does not go stale each year.
